시편-114-1.title: 시편 114장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-114-1.exegesis: 9. On this special case, compare 1Sa 2:21 . Barrenness was regarded as a disgrace, and is a type of a deserted Church ( Is 54:1 ). the barren woman ... house-- literally, "the barren of the house," so that the supplied words may be omitted.
